_note: Documentation only. Hook scripts self-gate via ORCH_HOOK_PROFILE; this file lists which hooks are active at each profile.

minimal.notes: Bootstrap only. Loads the Concise Agent Protocol meta-skill at SessionStart; no protocol reinforcement, no guard, no pruning.

standard.notes: Default. Bootstraps protocol; reinforces shape on each user turn; blocks --no-verify; fires the research gate on design-shape prompts; warns when subagents skip Status; validates researcher fidelity + writes brief index on clean outcomes; prunes trash and research cache on each Stop. ORCH_STRICT_RESEARCH=1 escalates research fidelity warnings to blocks.
